primary_question: Do upstream maritime activity anomalies from IMF PortWatch, weighted by fixed pre-PortWatch Census product exposure, reduce future BLS import-price forecast error beyond the frozen GSCPI baseline?
price_universe: same 18 BLS HS chapters used in prior pilot
baseline: frozen prior GSCPI model forecasts; incremental residual-correction test
origin_selection_rule: rank origin countries by 2017-2018 vessel import value over the frozen 18-HS universe; include countries through the first country that brings cumulative exposure to >=85%
transformations: monthly sums; causal YoY log1p changes; shortfall sign convention = negative growth becomes positive pressure
anti_leakage: Census exposure weights are fixed before PortWatch begins; no current-month Census flow is used in PortWatch features. Rolling training uses only residual targets realized by each forecast origin.
notes: PortWatch is revised historically; this is a pseudo-real-time historical test. A prospective immutable PortWatch vintage archive is required for production claims.
